cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned Excel/MSForms fixture input generated through public Excel/VBIDE automation and driven with public Windows input.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, non-public source, or OxForms output comparison.

notes: A TextBox focus host, a default OkButton CommandButton, and a ToggleCheck CheckBox laid out non-overlapping so a window-bounds + fixture-layout calculation can target each control by point.

Key (KeyDown/KeyUp), Click, Change, and Enter handlers each log one W008HeldKeyLog row recording the count-relevant field (KeyCode before/after for keys, .Value for ToggleCheck), the post-handler focus owner, and the relevant value, so a held-key auto-repeat run yields one row per repeat.

OkButton.Default is set to True at RUNTIME in UserForm_Initialize, never as a design-time fixture property; control fonts are intentionally not declared/applied (a design-time font set hangs the SaveAs dialog).

Load-bearing question (esq.12): does a held Space re-toggle the CheckBox per OS auto-repeat (multiple Change/Click) or once, and does a held default-button Enter re-fire Click per repeat? Genuine OS auto-repeat is best driven by computer-use hold_key; SendInput repeated-KEYDOWN is a best-effort fallback that may not set the auto-repeat lParam bit.
